errors.error_description: The always @(in_data) block reads 'en' but 'en' is not included in the sensitivity list, causing a mismatch.
A continuous assignment drives the input port bit 'in_data[0]' inside the module, violating port directionality.
Inside a sequential always block, 'valid' is assigned using blocking '=' while other registers use non-blocking '<=', creating a race.
The signal 'unused_debug' is declared but never used, representing unused/dead code.
